ValidationRule.description: Users should not be allowed to select interview outcome as ghosted manually as it is updated using flow.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( Interview_Outcome__c ), ISPICKVAL( Interview_Outcome__c , "Ghosted"), NOT(IsValidated__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Interview Outcome cannot be set to Ghosted manually. This value is system-managed and is updated automatically after 14 days from the Date of Interview.
